description: Figure 7 is a bar chart illustrating the number of questions, out of 40, where Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 using different methods contains at least one factual error. The horizontal axis lists three methods: “NoR QA,” “OneR QA,” and “IRCoT QA.” The vertical axis represents the count of such questions, scaled linearly from 0 to 40. Each method is represented by a single bar: “NoR QA” is shown in orange, “OneR QA” in red, and “IRCoT QA” in blue. The bar for “IRCoT QA” reaches approximately 20 on the vertical axis, indicating that in about 20 out of 40 questions, its generated CoT contained at least one factual error. The bar for “OneR QA” reaches approximately 33, indicating about 33 out of 40 questions contained at least one factual error. The bar for “NoR QA” reaches approximately 40, indicating that in all 40 questions, its generated CoT contained at least one factual error. The chart visually confirms the caption’s statement that the number of factual errors follows the order: IRCoT QA < OneR QA < NoR QA.
